qualificationStrategyRecommendation.requirements: Separate exact network routes and original-brand validation; shared bounded HTTP/press parsing may be reusable but is not qualified. At least three distinct series per proposed route, representative renewal/final/date forms, two independently identity-valid negative cases, strict ambiguity/cross-season safety, all seven replay fields, and repeated real runner access/title-driven discovery. Cancellation remains unsupported without explicit first-party proof. No current production policy lowered.
